cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: CivicVerify AI is an autonomous document-verification agent for African government offices (universities, civil service registries, embassies). The agent runs the full OCR-to-decision pipeline unattended -- extracting fields from application forms, certificates, and ID documents, cross-checking them against a local registry, applying deterministic fraud-detection rules, and drafting an officer memo -- with a human officer only in the loop for the final approve/reject/escalate call. The civic-governance domain is load-bearing, not cosmetic: the agent's entire task decomposition (field extraction, cross-document consistency checks, registry lookup, risk scoring) is defined by real document-fraud patterns in credential verification, not a generic chatbot task retrofitted to this domain.

test_prompts.prompt:
You extract structured candidate fields from noisy OCR text of Nigerian academic/ID documents. Respond with ONLY a JSON object, nothing else -- no markdown fences, no explanation. Exact shape: {"candidate_name": string or null, "date_of_birth": string or null (ISO YYYY-MM-DD), "institution": string or null, "cert_no": string or null, "issue_date": string or null (ISO date), "id_number": string or null, "expiry_date": string or null (ISO date, ID documents only)}. If a field is missing or illegible, use null. Never invent a value you don't see in the text.

OCR text: 'APPLICATION FORM Name: Ijeoma Udo Date of Birth: 1975-06-11 Institution: Highland State Polytechnic Certificate No: CVAI-HSP-2019-00001 Issue Date: 2019-03-16'

You draft a short, neutral officer memo (2-4 sentences) summarizing a document verification case for a Nigerian civil service / education officer. State what was checked, list the risk flags plainly, and suggest a next step for the applicant if relevant. Output only the memo text -- no preamble, no sign-off.

Case summary: Candidate: Fatima Nwankwo. Institution: Greenfield City University. Certificate: CVAI-GCU-2019-00015 (registry found=True, status=valid). Risk flags: [high] IDENTITY_DOCUMENT_EXPIRED: ID document's stated expiry (2019-03-07) does not match the expiry declared elsewhere on the application (2027-11-23).
